title: Chemical Awareness Scoring Methodology
purpose: A standardized educational framework for evaluating chemical formulations in consumer products based on toxicological evidence, exposure profiles, and ingredient properties.

scoringFactors.name: Ingredient Concern Profile
scoringFactors.description: Evaluates intrinsic toxicological hazards of ingredients in the formulation, including irritancy, contact allergenicity, and organ or cellular stress benchmarks.

scoringFactors.name: Exposure Characteristics
scoringFactors.description: Assesses the physical route of consumer contact, distinguishing between rinse-off cleansers, leave-on topicals, aerosols, and mucous-membrane exposures.

scoringFactors.name: Frequency of Use
scoringFactors.description: Weights standard consumer application intervals, distinguishing daily or multiple-times-daily personal care products from occasional household cleansers.

scoringFactors.name: Evidence Strength
scoringFactors.description: Measures the scientific maturity and regulatory consensus behind identified chemical concerns (peer-reviewed CIR monographs, ECHA dossiers, WHO/IARC reports).

scoringFactors.name: Concern Areas
scoringFactors.description: Scores multi-system overlap across human health endpoints and environmental/aquatic ecotoxicity persistence.

scoreCalculation.description: Sum the points across all five factors (0 to 100). Divide the total by 10, then take the maximum with 1.0 to produce a normalized score clamped between 1.0 and 10.0.

scoreBands.label: Lower identified concern
scoreBands.description: Formulation exhibits low overall hazard indicators relative to the evaluated product category.

scoreBands.label: Moderate identified concern
scoreBands.description: Formulation contains ingredients with moderate irritation potential, mild allergens, or higher frequency exposure.

scoreBands.label: Higher identified concern
scoreBands.description: Formulation combines multiple high-concern ingredients, frequent leave-on contact, or robust regulatory hazard listings.

scoreInterpretation: Higher level of identified chemical-awareness concerns based on the project's methodology.
disclaimer: This is an educational project metric and NOT an official medical, regulatory or safety rating.
limitations: Educational Scope: The scoring methodology is designed to facilitate consumer literacy and college research, not clinical diagnoses.
Label Transparency: Formulations rely on public packaging declarations (INCI names) and do not account for trade-secret proprietary concentrations unless publicly disclosed.
Individual Variation: Dermal sensitization and allergic reactivity vary widely across individual genetics, skin barrier health, and pre-existing atopic conditions.
Non-Regulatory Status: Scores reflect comparative academic evaluations and do not replace mandatory statutory compliance frameworks (EU Cosmetics Regulation, US FDA/FTC).
